paraphrase: Unattributed open bridge: whatever moves a body that perseveres in uniform rectilinear motion, in that respect, is a being by which the body perseveres in it. It identifies the case's present, per se mover with what Newton's definitions account for perseverance by; Garrigou-Lagrange denies it (the motion of Pure Act, on which physics cannot pronounce, 1914, pp. 760-761).
